explication: AI Runner is a local-first desktop companion and AI-art workspace backed by a headless service daemon. The primary flow is user conversation through the GUI and daemon to the LLM runtime, with streamed responses returned to the client; companion memory, RAG, and voice are adjacent stages. A separate canvas workflow covers image generation and editing. The README documents additional capabilities such as safety, environmental awareness, and model downloads. Those branches are represented at directory level where source was not sampled; edges are limited to documented package links and sampled calls.
